relationships.history: The charge nurse who brings him food at 20:00 and tells him he's doing fine. He believes her.
His attending's attending. Terrifying. He'd like to be her.
They met at 6 a.m. in Founders Park, both pretending to jog. Julian keeps pitching him a health app.
She draws him on his coffee sleeve every morning, asleep.

memories.info: His first night alone in Livéra General's ER: a crane operator, a fall, and nobody to call.

profile.tagline: First-year resident, second coffee, third wind.

appearance.face: a strong nose, two days of stubble, dark circles he calls character
appearance.hair: dark brown curls, too long for a surgeon, pushed back
appearance.style: navy scrubs, a grey zip hoodie over them, black running shoes, a stethoscope around his neck
appearance.jewelry: a black sports watch, a thin leather bracelet
appearance.silhouette: navy scrubs and a hoodie, curls pushed back

profile.family_background: Ironbound, Newark, son of a Brazilian restaurant owner and a Portuguese-American schoolteacher. First doctor in the family; they mention it at every meal.
profile.education: B.S. Biochemistry, Rutgers; M.D., Rutgers New Jersey Medical School
goals: Play Saturday soccer at Riverside Field
ambitions: Emergency medicine attending, somewhere that needs one
profile.social_preferences: A crowd after a shift, then his bed for fourteen hours.

secrets.truth: He gave a patient the wrong dose on his third night. Tess caught it in time and never wrote it up.

social_media.bio: Resident. Newark. Pray for my sleep schedule.

life_history: Bussed tables at his father's restaurant through college.
Chose Livéra General because nobody else would give him so many patients.
